get.description:
Get admin data requests.

GET alias for `/v1/admin/requests` - the POST-only literal on the
same path shadows the `/v1/admin/{resource}` catch-all for GET
requests (axum returns 405 instead of falling through), so the data
read must be registered explicitly, mirroring the secrets pattern.

post.description:
Sign.request.create .

create a signature request (opens immediately).

Approval binds to the signer's live session (CIBA-shaped rule,
DESIGN.md §4): the `sid` claim on the token is recorded; a replayed
or cross-session approval is rejected.

the session-bound signer decision.
